target_customer: B2B sales reps and sales leaders
problem: Reps spend up to 20 minutes after each call writing notes and updating CRM fields.
product_category: AI sales call notes and CRM automation

founders.name: Max Lu
founders.background_notes: YC page; TechCrunch says product engineer at Salesforce.

competitors.name: Winn.ai
competitors.what: AI assistant that tracks calls and updates CRM entries

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on transcription and LLM APIs; accuracy of field extraction is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Gong, Chorus and CRM vendors could add the feature and many startups launched similar tools.

market_need_then: TechCrunch reports a customer used it to fill 15 CRM fields, replacing a write up of up to 20 minutes.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic names, rebrand without public explanation.

outcome_analysis: Paragon AI, formerly Pilot AI, remains active with a small team and an angel round of $2.2M reported in March 2023. No later round or exit was found, and the market is crowded with conversation intelligence incumbents, so its outcome is still unclear.
notes: Stage marked other because TechCrunch calls it funding from angels without a stage. A $500K pre-seed in July 2022 appears only on Bouncewatch and is unverified. Winn.ai source is a March 2023 article citing its September 2022 launch, a few months after the batch. Gong and Chorus were not recorded because no dated source was found. Attention was covered in January 2023, after founding.
